subject: Pilot expansion + renewal amendment for Orchid Health — three new teams
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@orchidhealth.com>, Devon Lee <devon.lee@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot expansion + renewal amendment for Orchid Health — three new teams

Hi Samira / Devon,

Thanks again for a great sync yesterday. Per our conversation, Orchid is ready to run a second wave of pilots that will add three new product teams (CareOps, Intake, and BillingInsights) to the account. High-level asks we discussed: a) additional API keys for separate app environments, b) a short-term capacity bump for Q2-Q3 (token commit adjustment), and c) an amendment to the upcoming renewal to reflect the new projects and a phased billing schedule.

Proposed next steps (suggested timelines):
- Redwood to provide a draft Master Purchase Amendment (MPA) and a capacity plan by end of day Monday (4/13).
- Orchid team to confirm the list of applications (app IDs) and anticipated monthly token volumes by 4/16.
- Procurement kickoff (if needed) with your finance/ procurement contacts week of 4/20.

I've copied Monica from Customer Success to help scope the rollout and Rishi from Solutions (cc later) for technical sizing once we get the app IDs. To keep the pilots isolated, we'll provision three dedicated API keys (one per team) and recommend the following temporary limits:
- CareOps: 600k tokens/month
- Intake: 350k tokens/month
- BillingInsights: 250k tokens/month

Attaching a short pilot scope doc and a capacity workbook that show how this maps to your existing commit. If that looks good, I'll circulate an MPA draft for legal review.

Attachments: pilot_scope_v2.docx (pilot scope), orchid_capacity_plan.xlsx (proposed token split)

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Pilot expansion + renewal amendment for Orchid Health — three new teams

David —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick responses from our side:
- Confirming the three teams you listed. We'll send application IDs and a granular forecast by Friday 4/16.
- Procurement: I've looped in procure@orchidhealth.com for the amendment. They may request a consolidated quote and any standard security addenda.
- Capacity: The proposed temporary split looks reasonable but can you confirm if those tokens would draw from our existing committed pool or be billed as overage/one-off top-up? Also, do you offer short-term burst capacity for peak days?

Two asks from our product ops: 1) Can each API key be scoped to a restricted model set (we only want production-safe models for BillingInsights), and 2) Can we get tagging enabled per-key for cost attribution?

Thanks — we'll aim to get the IDs and a preliminary volume spread by 4/16.

Cheers,
Samira Khan
Head of Product Ops | Orchid Health

Subject: Re: Pilot expansion + renewal amendment for Orchid Health — three new teams

Samira —

Thanks for the quick turn. To answer your questions:
- Billing model: we can do the capacity in one of two ways — a temporary addendum to your current commit (recommended for simple billing consolidation) or a separate short-term top-up billed monthly. For the pilot, we typically suggest an amend-to-commit so usage counts against your committed units and avoids overage rate surprises. I'll mark that in the MPA.
- Burst capacity: yes — we support configured burst buffers for peak days (subject to pool availability). I'll include a suggested burst profile in the capacity workbook.
- Per-key model restriction: yes, we can pin a key to a reduced model set (prod safe only).
- Tagging: each key will emit tags for route and app; Monica will help configure cost attribution in the Console.

Attached: redwood_mpa_draft_v1.pdf (draft amendment with pricing table), orchid_capacity_plan.xlsx (updated with burst profile). Laura from Legal is cc'd to flag anything we should pre-empt in the MPA (standard exceptions, data residency notes). Monica, can you take point on the per-key tagging/playbook and provide a short rollout checklist?

If Orchid signs off on the proposed split, next steps for Redwood: finalize MPA, provision keys in a separate sandbox project, and schedule a CS-led onboarding call for the week of 4/26.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_mpa_draft_v1.pdf, orchid_capacity_plan.xlsx

David / Samira —

Thanks for the draft MPA and the capacity workbook. Procurement reviewed the pricing table and has two quick questions: 1) Can Orchid get net-30 payment terms on the incremental pilot fees, and 2) Is there a one-time implementation credit you can extend given the multi-team onboarding? They asked for a marked-up redline; I'll relay those edits once procurement compiles them.

On the technical side — production-safe model pinning + per-key tagging are must-haves for BillingInsights, so appreciate that confirmation. We'll bundle the app IDs and a conservative token forecast by EOD Thursday (4/16).

Monica — can you propose 2 x 30-min onboarding slots for week of 4/26? Prefer mornings PST.

Thanks,
Devon Lee
Director, Integrations | Orchid Health
